title: CI guardrails — PSScriptAnalyzer as a merge gate (PS ShellCheck)
objective: Run PSScriptAnalyzer on a shipped sample, capture the output to a file, and draft a CI step that fails the build on any Error/Warning finding -- wiring PSSA as the automated backstop the L7.3 checklist named, the same merge-gate posture bash L7.5 gives ShellCheck.
